headline: Reviews praise new Nintendo Switch Sports Resort as a Wii Sports revival
summary: Two reviews of Nintendo's new Switch Sports Resort describe it favorably as a worthy successor to Wii Sports, noting a generous mix of sport-themed games and calling Wii Sports historically Nintendo's best-selling software.

claims.statement: Both reviews describe the new Switch Sports Resort favorably as a return to the Wii Sports style of game.

sources.quote: Wii Sports is back on the Switch 2, and it rules
Nintendo Switch Sports Resort review – Wii Sports lives on in this effortlessly appealing collection of games

claims.statement: Wii Sports was historically the best-selling software Nintendo has made.

sources.quote: It's the best-selling piece of software the company has ever made

claims.statement: The new game offers a generous selection of sport-themed games with a holiday feel.

sources.quote: Bringing a holiday vibe and a generous selection of sport-themed games, this is exactly what you want from a family video game
